output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as the difference between the total balance and the buy price, which can be zero.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the amount is calculated as the difference between the total balance and the sell price, which can be zero.
The setPrices function has an integer overflow where the new sell and buy prices are set as zero, which can be detrimental to the contract owner.
The freezeAccount function has an integer overflow where the target address is set as zero, which can be detrimental to the contract owner.
